question_en:
The attachment is an official exterior image of a teaching building on the main campus of a university. Please answer the following questions:

1. Which university, which campus, and which building are shown in the image? Please provide the building's official code.
2. Taking the building cards displayed on the university's official "Explore Campus Classrooms" page as the full set, count each physical entity only once, while keeping different entities separate. How many building entities are there after deduplication?
3. Check the main exterior image on each entity card. Which buildings have skybridges spanning across buildings? Please provide the formal name, official code, and source for all matching buildings.

Answer format: For Question 1, provide the university, campus, building, and official code in text; for Question 2, provide the total number of deduplicated building entities in text; for Question 3, list the formal name, official code, and source link for all matching buildings in a table.
answer:
Question 1: University: University of Ottawa; Campus: Main Campus; Building: Tabaret Hall; Official Code: TBT.

Question 2: 23.

Question 3:

| Formal Building Name | Official Code | Source Link |

| Fauteux Hall | FTX | https://www.uottawa.ca/about-us/fauteux-hall-teaching-spaces-layout |
| Jock Turcot University Centre | UCU | https://www.uottawa.ca/about-us/jock-turcot-university-centre-teaching-spaces-layout |
| Morisset Hall | MRT | https://www.uottawa.ca/about-us/morisset-hall-teaching-spaces-layout |

Action: View the current final-image-real input; record the scene structure before establishing search terms.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): The current image shows a classical teaching building beside a campus walkway, featuring a prominent right-side pediment, emblem, and colonnade, with steps in front and lawn and trees to the left; no directly readable building code is visible in the image.

Result of this step: Formulated image candidate clues; the image itself does not serve as proof of external identity, tenure, awards, or release date.

Action: Divide the task into image localization, complete candidate set, item-by-item visual screening, and hit verification; example queries: "University of Ottawa Tabaret Hall exterior"; "uOttawa Explore classrooms on campus".

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): The actual building cards on the official "Explore Campus Classrooms" page constitute the full set; count each physical entity only once while keeping different entities separate. The main exterior image must show a skybridge spanning between buildings; the existence of other skybridges in reality cannot substitute for their visibility in the card's main image.
